source.title: 量子力学习题解（曾谨言）
source.chapter: 第五章： 对称性及守恒定律
source.pdf_file: 量子力学：习题解-曾谨言.pdf

raw_problem.problem_text:
多粒子系若不受外力，则其哈密顿算符可表成：

$$
\hat {H} = \sum_ {i} \frac {1}{2 m _ {i}} \hat {p} _ {i} ^ {2} + \sum_ {\substack {i, j \\ i <   j}} V [ / \vec {r} _ {i} - \vec {r} _ {j} / ] \tag{1}
$$
raw_problem.solution_text:
证明：总动量 $\hat { \vec { p } } = \sum _ { i } \hat { \vec { p } } _ { i }$ 为守恒。 ⑵

[证明]：待证一试是矢量算符，可以证明其 $\mathbf { X }$ 分量的守恒关系，即为足够按力学量守恒条件这要求： $[ \hat { p } _ { x } , \hat { H } ] = 0$ ⑶

$$
\begin{array}{l} [ \hat {p} _ {x}, \hat {H} ] = [ \sum_ {i} \hat {p} _ {i x}, \sum_ {i} \frac {1}{2 m _ {i}} \hat {p} _ {i} ^ {2} + \sum_ {i, j} V (\left. / \vec {r} _ {i} - \vec {r} _ {j} \right\vert) ] \\ = \left[ \sum_ {i} \hat {p} _ {i x}, \sum_ {i} \frac {1}{2 m _ {i}} \hat {p} _ {i} ^ {2} \right] + \left[ \sum_ {i} \hat {p} _ {i x}, \sum_ {i, j} V \left(\left. / \vec {r} _ {i} - \vec {r} _ {j} \right.\right) \right] \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} = \left[ \hat {p} _ {1 x} + \hat {p} _ {2 x} \dots \hat {p} _ {i x} \dots , \frac {1}{2 m _ {i}} \left(\hat {p} _ {1 x} ^ {2} + \hat {p} _ {1 y} ^ {2} + \hat {p} _ {1 y} ^ {2}\right) + \dots + \frac {1}{2 m _ {i}} \left(\hat {p} _ {i x} ^ {2} + \hat {p} _ {i y} ^ {2} + \hat {p} _ {i y} ^ {2}\right) \dots \right] + \\ \left[ \hat {p} _ {1 x} + \hat {p} _ {2 x} \dots \hat {p} _ {i x} \dots , V \left(\left. / \vec {r} _ {1} - \vec {r} _ {2} / \right.) + V \left(\left. / \vec {r} _ {2} - \vec {r} _ {3} / \right.\right) \dots V \left(\left. / \vec {r} _ {i} - \vec {r} _ {j} / \right.\right) + \dots \right] \right. \tag {4} \\ \end{array}
$$

最后一式的第一个对易式中，因为：

$$
[ \hat {p} _ {i x}, \hat {p} _ {j y} ^ {2} ] = 0, [ \hat {p} _ {i z}, \hat {p} _ {j y} ^ {2} ] = 0, [ \hat {p} _ {i x}, \hat {p} _ {j z} ] = 0
$$

故整个 $[ \sum _ { i } \hat { p } _ { i x } , \sum _ { i } \frac { 1 } { 2 m _ { i } } \hat { p } _ { i } ^ { ~ 2 } ] = 0$

至于第二个对易式中，其相互势能之和有以下的形式

$$
\begin{array}{l} \sum_{i,j}V[\overrightarrow{r}_{i} - \overrightarrow{r}_{j}  /] = \sum_{\substack{i,j\\ i <   j}}V(x_{i} - x_{j},y_{i} - y_{j},z_{i} - z_{j}) \\ = \frac {1}{2} \sum_ {i, j} \left\{V \left(x _ {i} - x _ {j}, y _ {i} - y _ {j}, z _ {i} - z _ {j}\right) + V \left(x _ {i} - x _ {j}, y _ {i} - y _ {j}, z _ {i} - z _ {j}\right) \right\} \\ \end{array}
$$

又⑷式的第二对易式又能用分配律写成许多对易式之和，由于不同座标的座标算符和动量算符永远能够对易，⑷式又能简化成：

$$
\begin{array}{l} [ \hat {p} _ {x}, \hat {H} ] = \sum_ {i} [ \hat {p} _ {i x}, \sum_ {j} \hat {V} (x _ {i} - x _ {j}, y _ {i} - y _ {j}, z _ {i} - z _ {j}) ] \\ = \sum_ {i} \sum_ {j} \left[ \hat {p} _ {i x}, \frac {1}{2} \left\{\hat {V} \left(x _ {i} - x _ {j}, y _ {i} - y _ {j}, z _ {i} - z _ {j}\right) + \hat {V} \left(x _ {j} - x _ {i}, y _ {j} - y _ {i}, z _ {j} - z _ {i}\right) \right\} \right] (6) \\ \end{array}
$$

再运用对易式（第四章 11 题）

$$
[ \hat {p} _ {i x}, F (x _ {i}) ] = \frac {\hbar}{i} [ \frac {\partial}{\partial x _ {i}}, F (x _ {i}) ] = \frac {\hbar}{i} \frac {\partial V (x _ {i})}{\partial x _ {i}}
$$

代入上式得：

$$
\begin{array}{l} [ \hat {p} _ {x}, \hat {H} ] = \sum_ {i} \sum_ {j} [ \hat {p} _ {i x}, \frac {1}{2} [ \hat {V} (x _ {i} - x _ {j}, y _ {i} - y _ {j}, z _ {i} - z _ {j}) ] + \sum_ {i} \sum_ {j} [ \hat {p} _ {i x}, \frac {1}{2} [ \hat {V} (x _ {j} - x _ {i}, y _ {j} - y _ {i}, z _ {j} - z _ {i}) ] ] \\ = \sum_ {i} \sum_ {j} \frac {\hbar}{2 i} \frac {\partial V}{\partial x _ {i}} - \sum \sum \frac {\hbar}{2 i} \frac {\partial V}{\partial x _ {i}} = 0 \\ \end{array}
$$

满足⑶式，故⑵式得征。
